name: Vaultbreaker
description: A high-stakes vault job under the cover of night.

events.description: You arrive on the rooftop overlooking the bank.

choices.label: Climb down to the back door

events.title: Start Rooftop

events.description: You crawl through the sewers and find a maintenance hatch.
events.title: Start Sewer

events.description: You boldly approach the front door in disguise.
events.title: Start Frontdoor

events.description: A late-night delivery truck stops by; you slip in with the driver.

choices.label: Hide in the truck and jump out inside
Confront the driver and take his ID

events.title: Start Truck

events.description: You find an unlocked service door used by staff.
events.title: Start Service Door

events.description: You approach the vault door. The guard is still here.
events.title: Vault Entry

events.description: The guard fights back fiercely!
events.title: Guard Fight

events.description: You sneak past the guard and reach the security room.
events.title: Sneak Success

events.description: The cameras go dark. You move deeper into the vault corridors.
events.title: Cameras Disabled

events.description: You notice the guard's patrol pattern.
events.title: Guard Pattern Found

events.description: The guard goes to investigate the noise.
events.title: Guard Distracted

events.description: You find a hidden ladder leading up into the bank.
events.title: Hidden Entry

events.description: You set a trap behind you, slowing down any pursuers.
events.title: Trap Set

events.description: You find a blueprint of the vault layout.
events.title: Blueprint Found

events.description: You discover an air vent that might lead into the vault.

choices.label: Try to widen the vent opening

events.title: Vent Found

events.description: You're in the main vault corridor. Heavy footsteps echo in the distance.
events.title: Vault Corridor

events.description: The guard is unconscious. You have some time before he's discovered.
events.title: Guard Knocked Out
Lockpick Minigame
events.description: To succeed, you must crack a **4-digit security code**.
You find a room filled with safety deposit boxes and loose valuables.

choices.label: Set up for a bigger heist later (take blueprints instead)

events.title: Side Loot Room

events.description: The guard's keycard might open restricted areas.

choices.label: Try the keycard on the vault

events.title: Keycard Acquired

events.description: The vault door swings open, revealing treasures beyond your wildest dreams.
events.title: Vault Opened

events.description: You successfully crawl through the vent and drop into the vault.
events.title: Vent Entry

events.description: Your movement creates noise that echoes through the building. Guards are getting suspicious.
events.title: Noise Made

events.description: A guard becomes suspicious and starts actively searching for intruders.
events.title: Guard Alert

events.description: You've spent too much time on preparation. Dawn is approaching and security will change shifts soon.
events.title: Time Wasted

events.description: A minor alarm is triggered, but hasn't alerted the full security yet. You have moments to act.

choices.label: Run for the vault before backup arrives

events.title: Alarm Minor

events.description: The guard is getting suspicious of your presence but hasn't acted yet.

choices.label: Try to convince him you belong here
Create a distraction and slip away

events.title: Guard Suspicious

events.description: The guard is asking for your identification and authorization to be here.

choices.label: Knock him out before he can react

events.title: Identity Questioned

events.description: The guard has called for backup. More security is on the way.
events.title: Backup Called

events.description: You're hurt from the fight but still mobile. Blood might leave a trail.
events.title: Injured

events.description: A guard is actively chasing you through the building.

choices.label: Try to lose him in the corridors
Set a trap to stop him

events.title: Guard Pursuit

events.description: The smoke bomb worked, but the guard is still nearby and confused.

choices.label: Knock him out while he can't see

events.title: Guard Confused

events.description: Your electronic equipment malfunctions at a critical moment.
events.title: Technical Failure

events.description: You successfully plant a listening device and gather valuable intelligence.
events.title: Intel Gathered

events.description: You encounter a routine security patrol making their rounds.
events.title: Guard Patrol

events.description: The door you need is locked with an electronic lock.
events.title: Locked Door

events.description: You've gotten turned around in the maze-like interior of the bank.
events.title: Lost In Building

events.description: Your timing was off and you're caught in an awkward position.

choices.label: Freeze and hope they don't notice

events.title: Timing Wrong

events.description: The distracted guard returns sooner than expected.
events.title: Guard Returns

events.description: The old ladder gives way under your weight, but you manage to catch yourself.
events.title: Ladder Breaks

events.description: Some of your equipment is damaged or lost in the chaos.
events.title: Equipment Lost

events.description: The ventilation system is damaged and making noise. Guards might investigate.
events.title: Vent Damage

events.description: You're wedged in the ventilation system and struggling to move.
events.title: Stuck In Vent

events.description: The truck driver is getting suspicious of your presence in his vehicle.

choices.label: Try to bluff your way out
Jump out and find another way

events.title: Driver Suspicious

events.description: The truck driver fights back when you try to take his credentials.
events.title: Driver Fight

events.description: Your lockpicking tools break at a critical moment.
events.title: Lockpick Broken

events.description: The guard believes your story and lets you proceed.
events.title: Front Bluff Success

events.description: The patrol passes by without noticing you.
events.title: Patrol Passed

events.description: You've successfully hidden the unconscious guard's body.
events.title: Body Hidden

events.description: The keycard grants you access to a high-security area with advanced safes.
events.title: Restricted Area

events.description: After widening the vent, you gain easier access to the vault.
events.title: Vent Widened

events.description: You find a maintenance closet to hide in while things cool down.
events.title: Hiding Spot

events.description: You discover an emergency exit that might lead outside.

choices.label: Mark it and continue the heist

events.title: Back Exit Found

events.description: You observe the guard's routine from the shadows.

choices.label: Follow him to learn the layout

events.title: Guard Watch

events.description: You've set up a perfect ambush position in the corridor.
events.title: Ambush Ready

events.description: It's time to pick what to take. Your choices now determine whether you escape successfully.

choices.label: Grab stacks of cash and run

events.title: Final Loot

events.description: The information you found is outdated and leads you astray.
events.title: Outdated Info

events.description: The keycard doesn't work on this lock. Security might have been updated.

choices.label: Try to hack the system manually

events.title: Keycard Invalid

events.description: In your haste to grab loot, you drop some valuable equipment.
events.title: Equipment Dropped

events.description: The knocked-out guard regains consciousness sooner than expected.

choices.label: Run before he can raise alarm

events.title: Guard Wakes

events.description: Your injury is leaving a blood trail that guards might follow.
events.title: Blood Trail

events.description: The ventilation system collapses, trapping you inside until security finds you.
events.title: Vent Collapse

events.description: The alarm blares and security swarms the building. Your heist is over.
events.title: Alarm Triggered

events.description: Multiple guards converge on your position and overpower you completely.
events.title: Overwhelmed

events.description: A guard catches you in the act and the heist ends in capture.
events.title: Caught By Guard

events.description: You find yourself cornered with no way out as security closes in.
events.title: Dead End

events.description: You managed to escape through the back exit!
events.title: Escape Success

events.description: You managed to escape successfully with your loot!
events.title: Escape Success

events.description: Against all odds, you manage to take everything valuable and escape.
events.title: Maximum Loot
